display.title: Authoritative Server — Tween & Raycast Capability Harness
display.description: Runs the SAME Tween + Raycast test suite twice — once on the headless authoritative server, once locally on the client — and shows the two verdicts side by side. A server that lacks the tween/raycast systems never writes TweenState / RaycastResult, so every server column entry times out and fails while the client column passes: that CLIENT-pass / SERVER-fail split is the signal. Includes an always-on live rig (server-tweened platform crossing a server-cast tripwire beam) that needs BOTH features working server-side to ever register a hit.
